key_idea: A card that covers part of another card lies on top of it.
steps: The pink card 2 is not covered at all, so it is on top.
Card 2 covers card 5. Card 5 covers card 1.
Card 1 covers card 4, and card 4 covers card 3.
So the cards are picked up 2-5-1-4-3.

choice_feedback.A: Card 1 lies on top of card 4, so card 1 is picked up before card 4.
choice_feedback.C: Card 2 lies on top of card 5, so card 2 is picked up first.
choice_feedback.D: Card 5 lies on top of card 1, so card 5 is picked up before card 1.
choice_feedback.E: This is the order from the bottom up. Card 3 is at the very bottom.
